title: Elite: The Forgotten Standard Falls
description: The Forgotten Banner: The Forgotten Standard Falls unfolds across wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian squad to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: The Forgotten Standard Falls advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: wind-torn bridge causeway with shredded banners, rusted standard sockets, and buckled oath plates

objectives.primary: Destroy the Forgotten banner sockets before their command spreads. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.
optional: Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

boss.notes: Boss pressure tied to banner command and broken-oath memory.

specialRules: Banner Pressure: enemy banners grant defense until physically broken by objective actions.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Elite Storm: lightning collapse advances one turn earlier.
Elite Banner Law: enemy buffs persist until objective action breaks the source.
victoryConditions: Destroy the Forgotten banner sockets before their command spreads. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
meaningfulDifferences: Boss or elite wave uses altered entry timing

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.
